limitations: Machine-extracted L1 cases are not human-verified; L2 requires REVIEWED_L2_CASE_IDS.
Citations that are not Civil Code articles 1-1260 are not written to related_provision_ids and are not retained as raw citations in this dataset.

Every legal-rag civil case and a balanced subset of LexRel expert-annotated civil relations remains a deep CaseRecord for text retrieval. Refund-rule condition bridges are limited to SERVICE_REFUND_COMPARISON_CASE_IDS. The gym refund rule is invoked only for prepaid-closure / 解除+返还 cases in that set. LexRel train splits are unused; the retrieval subset is capped per relation type.

Holdings, reasoning steps, and court findings are omitted when they cannot be anchored in 法院经审理查明/法院认定, 裁判理由, or the judgment 主文. 诉称 and 辩称 are never written as CourtFinding records. UNKNOWN conditions mean the source does not establish the predicate; they are not NOT_SATISFIED.
CourtFinding records are taken from 法院经审理查明/法院认定, never from 诉称 or 辩称.
Condition mapping is conservative machine heuristics and always sets human_verified=false.
